title: 对账中心：调整发票状态字段
description: 给 reconciliation_invoice 加一个状态字段，顺便补个索引。
author: zhangsan
diff:
diff --git a/backend/doc/sql/10_reconciliation_tables.sql b/backend/doc/sql/10_reconciliation_tables.sql
index 1a2b3c4..5d6e7f8 100644
--- a/backend/doc/sql/10_reconciliation_tables.sql
+++ b/backend/doc/sql/10_reconciliation_tables.sql
@@ -18,7 +18,9 @@ CREATE TABLE reconciliation_invoice (
   invoice_no  VARCHAR(64)   NOT NULL COMMENT '发票号',
   amount      DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL COMMENT '金额',
+  status      TINYINT       NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '状态：0 待开票 1 已开票 2 已红冲',
   created_at  DATETIME      NOT NULL,
   PRIMARY KEY (id)
-) COMMENT='对账发票表';
+) COMMENT='对账发票表';
+
+CREATE INDEX idx_invoice_status ON reconciliation_invoice(status);
diff --git a/backend/modules/reconciliation/src/main/java/com/example/reconciliation/entity/Invoice.java b/backend/modules/reconciliation/src/main/java/com/example/reconciliation/entity/Invoice.java
index 2b3c4d5..6e7f8a9 100644
--- a/backend/modules/reconciliation/src/main/java/com/example/reconciliation/entity/Invoice.java
+++ b/backend/modules/reconciliation/src/main/java/com/example/reconciliation/entity/Invoice.java
@@ -24,4 +24,7 @@ public class Invoice {
     /** 金额 */
     private BigDecimal amount;
+
+    /** 状态：0 待开票 1 已开票 2 已红冲 */
+    private Integer status;
 }
diff --git a/backend/modules/reconciliation/src/main/resources/mapper/InvoiceMapper.xml b/backend/modules/reconciliation/src/main/resources/mapper/InvoiceMapper.xml
index 3c4d5e6..7f8a9b0 100644
--- a/backend/modules/reconciliation/src/main/resources/mapper/InvoiceMapper.xml
+++ b/backend/modules/reconciliation/src/main/resources/mapper/InvoiceMapper.xml
@@ -8,6 +8,7 @@
     <resultMap id="InvoiceMap" type="Invoice">
         <result column="invoice_no" property="invoiceNo"/>
         <result column="amount"     property="amount"/>
+        <result column="status"     property="status"/>
     </resultMap>
